summary: Jaguar Health filed an 8-K on September 21, 2026, reporting a September 15 Certificate of Elimination clearing its Third Amended and Restated Certificate of Incorporation of all matters relating to fourteen series of Specified Series Preferred Stock (B-2 through O), with no shares outstanding before filing, returning them to authorized but undesignated preferred. Separately, on September 17, 2026, the company effected a 1-for-15 reverse stock split of its $0.0001 par common, leaving roughly 520,088 shares outstanding. No price, premium, board recommendation, or advisor is stated. What to watch: post-split trading liquidity and any future preferred designations.
